name: General Data Protection Regulation
authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
description: The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is a comprehensive data protection law that governs the collection, processing, and protection of personal data of individuals within the European Union and European Economic Area.

domains.name: Data Processing Principles
domains.description: Core principles for lawful data processing (Articles 5-11)

domains.name: Data Subject Rights
domains.description: Rights of individuals regarding their personal data (Articles 12-23)

domains.name: Controller and Processor Obligations
domains.description: Responsibilities for data controllers and processors (Articles 24-43)

domains.name: International Transfers
domains.description: Rules for transferring data outside the EEA (Articles 44-50)

metadata.notes: Applies to organizations processing EU residents' personal data, regardless of organization location
